bio: At the southern end of the Corniche sits this wonderfully decorated restaurant that features bold colours and an opulent edge, with comfortable sofa seating and polished tiled flooring adding to its appeal. The authentic Qatari and Gulf State dishes are generous in size, eye-catching in looks and yield refined flavours and textures. You could start your meal with crisp Mzatara Samboussa, then move onto one of the particularly good lamb main courses, before the Donafa Ain Helaitan provides a satisfying conclusion....
